model_policy: Retain 2026-09-05 long-horizon owner-cash scenario architecture for comparability; synchronize only price and reverse expectations. Scenario values are estimates, not targets.

market_multiples_diagnostic.note: These are diagnostics. OCF-PPE is not normalized owner FCF; the conservative proxy deducts SBC once and should not be combined with a second dilution haircut for the same awards.

reverse_expectations.method: Use retained TTM revenue $14.732B, 15% starting owner margin, linearly reaching 24% by year 10, 23x terminal equity FCF multiple and 9% required return; solve constant 10-year revenue CAGR to reprice $131.24.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: The current price requires demanding but not Bull-only growth. PASS on unrealistic-bull veto does not equal an approved buy because four non-price evidence gates remain open.

two_state_note: Algebraic location only, not a probability estimate.
no_double_counting: Debt interest remains inside owner-margin economics; cash/debt is not separately added to the FCFE-style equity model.
SBC is treated as an economic expense in the owner-cash proxy; do not also apply a free-standing dilution haircut for the same awards.
Future acquisition purchase prices and speculative strategic-investment exits are excluded from scenario value.
